title: Rocket ship with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rocket body -->
  <rect x='35' y='30' width='30' height='45' rx='8' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <rect x='35' y='30' width='10' height='45' rx='8' fill='#c8c8d8'/>
  <!-- nose cone -->
  <path d='M50 5 Q65 25 65 35 L35 35 Q35 25 50 5Z' fill='#ff5566'/>
  <!-- nose cone highlight -->
  <path d='M50 8 Q60 24 60 33 L50 33 Q50 24 50 8Z' fill='#ff8899'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='10' fill='#44ccff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='7' fill='#2299dd'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='47' r='3' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <!-- smile on window -->
  <path d='M45 53 Q50 58 55 53' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes on window -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- left fin -->
  <path d='M35 55 L18 78 L35 75 Z' fill='#ff5566'/>
  <path d='M35 59 L24 76 L35 74 Z' fill='#ff8899'/>
  <!-- right fin -->
  <path d='M65 55 L82 78 L65 75 Z' fill='#ff5566'/>
  <path d='M65 59 L76 76 L65 74 Z' fill='#ff8899'/>
  <!-- body stripe -->
  <rect x='35' y='63' width='30' height='6' fill='#ff5566'/>
  <!-- bottom nozzle -->
  <rect x='42' y='75' width='16' height='8' rx='2' fill='#8888a0'/>
  <rect x='42' y='75' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#aaaacc'/>
  <!-- flame outer -->
  <path d='M42 83 Q40 93 50 98 Q60 93 58 83 Z' fill='#ffaa22'/>
  <!-- flame inner -->
  <path d='M46 83 Q45 90 50 93 Q55 90 54 83 Z' fill='#ffee44'/>
</svg>
